operation_details.item: The user does not drink alcohol by lifelong personal choice and prefers non-alcoholic beverages.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I see you have a client event next week. Are you excited about the networking opportunities?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I'm looking forward to it. I've been planning the approach to make sure everything goes smoothly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's great. Do you have any particular preferences for the event's refreshments or beverages?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Actually, I do have a specific preference. I do not drink alcohol as a lifelong personal choice and prefer non-alcoholic beverages at social and business events. So I'll need to make sure there are good options available.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood, I'll keep that in mind. There are plenty of sophisticated mocktails and non-alcoholic wines that can fit seamlessly into a business setting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That would be perfect. I don't want to feel out of place when others are having cocktails.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely. I can prepare a curated list of alcohol-free options that are popular and elegant. Would you like me to share that?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, please. Also, I'll need to double-check the ingredients of any provided drinks to ensure they're truly alcohol-free.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great precaution. Some items like kombucha or certain desserts can contain trace alcohol, so verifying is wise. I'll include that note in my recommendations.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I want to be confident in my choices and maintain my personal commitment.
